No docker_image, allow_internet or allowed_hosts anywhere in task.toml; per SKILL.md line 26 a missing allowlist on public network is correct (the Internal Quality Checks annotation's '+ allowlist' is superseded by the delivery profile and the client Quality Checks text 'Network is public - no allowlist required'). tests/Dockerfile sha256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd equals the template's tests/Dockerfile byte-for-byte: tag-pinned bases node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim (lines 1-2), exact npm versions @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1 (lines 16-22), harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 (line 31), Chromium installed via the pinned Playwright MCP's own CLI (lines 33-39), COPY . /tests (line 43). .dockerignore identical to template. Judge model: grep for '^\s*model\s*=' across task/tests returns nothing. All five judge.toml files (gates/render, gates/constraints, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual) carry only judge = "claude-code" at line 5 (the expected fallback) plus a comment that the model comes from [verifier.env]; no model, reasoning effort or temperature key. test.sh (identical to template) refuses to run if REWARDKIT_JUDGE/REWARDKIT_MODEL are unset (lines 63-64) and does not override ANTHROPIC_* vars; tools/ identical to template. Adversarial probes: (a) a broken app cannot exploit this row - the verifier is a separate image built from tests/ with /tests chmod go-rwx, and the judge key/model are injected only through [verifier.env], not from anything the agent writes. (b) A conforming app cannot fail due to this row's wiring except via platform credential availability, which is not a task defect. Note (not a defect, template-controlled): base images are tag-pinned, not digest-pinned, and apt packages are unversioned; this is the unchanged shared template Dockerfile, which AGENTS.md says must be preserved. Note on evidence: this row is a static wiring check and was verified from source; no full configured verifier launch/grading run exists in raw-evidence-index.json (its scope states full configured grading is absent), so this pass does not claim the OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolves at runtime or any judge/Oracle/portal score; that runtime gap belongs to the workload/full-verifier-launch rows.
